LESSON: COMMUNITY LEADERSHIP - RELIGIOUS LEADERS - CLAN LEADERS - VILLAGE LEADERS

Grade: SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four
Subject: SOCIAL STUDIES
Strand: Citizenship and Governance In Kenya
Topic 5.6: Community Leadership - Religious leaders - Clan leaders - village leaders
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 5

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Community Leadership - Religious leaders - Clan leaders - village leaders, part of Citizenship and Governance In Kenya in SNE  /  hearing-impairment / Grade four SOCIAL STUDIES.

Key inquiry question: Why is it important for leaders to have good qualities? 2. How can you identify a good leader in the community?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Community Leadership - Religious leaders - Clan leaders - village leaders together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Values:
Love: learners display self-sacrifice as they put the interests of others before their interest as they use digital or print

resources to find out the qualities of a good leader

Pertinent and Contemporary Issues:
(PCIs) :

Effective communication: learners develop effective communication skills as they Brainstorm in groups to identify leaders in the

community (Council of Elders, Religious and Cultural Leaders)

Links to other Learning Areas:
● Religious Education: learners relate to good leadership qualities learnt in Religious Education as they design posters on

qualities of good leadership in the community.

● Creative Arts: learners relate to skills learnt in creative Arts as they design and display a poster on qualities of good leadership

in the community
